name: Liren
summary: A Dragonborn Barbarian in the party who trusts Malron.

facts.text: Intimidated Milivoj into confessing to the bone theft.
Severed Izek's right arm with her axe after the fight at the lake.
Found the Locket of the Last Laugh.
Heard Victor's voice asking her to return with a plan.
Chose a silver stone from Strahd and bought Gleaming Half Plate from Minofaustus.
Chose blood in Strahd's hourglass game.

name: Gumbo
summary: A Half-Orc Rogue in the party with a knack for unexpected solutions.

facts.text: Used Mage Hand to open the Blue Water Inn's latch from inside.
Was caught by Izek while swapping in the poisoned wine, but Izek thought he was stealing it.
Found the hags' contract, six pieces of cheap jewelry and the Charm of Mass Heroism.
Saw a vision of victory and a cheering crowd in the Whispering Wall.
Traded gold to Minofaustus for a Cloak of Elvenkind and took Zorpheus as his servant.

name: Aera shan Ravanór
summary: A Wood-elf Rogue in the party who fights with twin knitting needles and a bow.

facts.text: Took the Bones of St. Andral from the bag and handed them to Malron.
Was invited to dinner by Fiona Wachter.
Refused when Strahd appeared at her window asking to be let in.
Stole Izek's old bottle of wine.
Bought a Shades Ring from Minofaustus and owes him 500 more gold.
Was detected while invisible, starting the fight in the werewolf cave.
Drank the blood in Strahd's game and fully transformed into a werewolf.

name: Malron Lichtstrahl
summary: A Reborn Cleric of Lathander who shares his body with an ancient Elf spirit.

facts.text: Triggered a poison dart trap in Henrik's wardrobe and was paralyzed.
Attached Izek's magical arm to Shabasta.
Used the Talisman of Echoes to speak with Izek's head.
Was once poisoned by a Giant Spider; a resurrection let an Elf spirit into his body.
Learned in the Whispering Wall that he is tied to an ancient line of elven kings.
Promised to deliver Marzena's flower necklace.
Silenced himself for a day in Strahd's game rather than abandon his faith.

name: Shabasta
summary: A porcupine bard in the party with a flair for disguise and dramatic speeches.

facts.text: Disguised himself as Father Lucian to get guards to arrest Milivoj.
Disguised himself as Blinsky and was shot at by the Baron's guards.
Had Izek's magical arm attached to him.
Gave a speech that saved Milivoj and Henrik from hanging.
Died fighting the gallows speaker and could not be brought back.

name: Olfin Darning
summary: A Hexblood Paladin in the party.

facts.text: Sent some of his hair to Ireena to warn her about Izek.
Earned Lady Fiona's trust so she lowered the binding circle.
Negotiated entry into the hags' windmill with Shabasta.
Received the Symbol of Ravenkind from Zuleika for promising to rescue Emil.
Let his weapon be cursed rather than swear fealty to Strahd.

name: Oogway
summary: A turtle Wizard Bladesinger who emerged mysteriously from a lake.

facts.text: Interrogated Izek's head about his arm and the Order of the Feather.
Learned from Erasmus that the gallows speaker had no weaknesses.
Bought potions of healing from the wandering merchant.
Killed the last werewolf with a delayed Booming Blade.
Gave up his name in Strahd's game.

name: Veyren
summary: Shabasta's hare-like brother, a druid who joined the party.

facts.text: Joined the party and received Shabasta's letter.
Turned into a mouse to spy on a druid torturing a raven.
Read druidic runes about Kavan the Blood Drinker.
Asked Strahd why some people move freely in his domain.
Was killed by Winter Splinter's explosive death.

name: Zorpheus
summary: A mysterious wanderer and bard, a former thief, drawn to fate and prophecy.

facts.text: Heard the prophecy confirmed in the Whispering Wall and barely escaped.
Was given to Gumbo as a servant by Minofaustus.
Cast Suggestion to make the last werewolf lead them to the prisoners.
Chose blood in Strahd's hourglass game.

name: Father Lucian
summary: A priest in Vallaki who helps the party recover the Bones of St. Andral.

facts.text: Led the party to Milivoj's home and fought Volenta with them.
Received the bones to bless them and renew the church's ward.
Argued with guards at the town square.

name: Milivoj
summary: A poor young man in Vallaki who stole the Bones of St. Andral to support his siblings.

facts.text: Confessed to selling the bones to Henrik; his parents are addicted to dream pastries.
Was condemned to death by hanging.
Was set free after Rahadin rolled a 20.

name: Henrik
summary: A Vallaki shop owner who bought the stolen Bones of St. Andral.

facts.text: Bought the bones from Milivoj and was arrested by guards.
Bought a noise toy from Blinsky.
Was condemned to death by hanging.
Was branded with the symbol of Castle Ravenloft instead of hanged.

name: Volenta
summary: A bride of Strahd.

facts.text: Escaped the fight at Henrik's shop, leaving mists and a glowing pentagram.
Ludmilla openly scorns her.

name: Ireena
summary: A young woman Strahd seeks, who later joins the party as a healer and swordsman.

facts.text: Was to stay at the church under the renewed ward.
Izek ransacked the Blue Water Inn looking for her.
Izek's lost sister may be her.
Rahadin requested her presence at dinner at Castle Ravenloft.
Joined the party, saying the Abbey cannot protect her from Strahd.
Came out of the Whispering Wall in tears and would not share her vision near Strahd.

name: Urwin Martikov
summary: Innkeeper of the Blue Water Inn and a member of the Keepers of the Feather.

facts.text: Was found sweeping glass after Izek ransacked his inn.
Asked the party to check on the overdue Wizard of Wines shipment and his father.
Is the son of Davian Martikov.
Was revealed as a Keeper of the Feather.

name: Izek Strazni
summary: The Baron of Vallaki's enforcer, with a flaming demon arm.

facts.text: Ransacked the Blue Water Inn looking for Ireena and set Blinsky's store on fire.
Lost his arm to a wolf as a child when his sister went missing.
Drank the poisoned wine at the lake and was killed by the party.
His head, questioned through the Talisman of Echoes, revealed the Order of the Feather.
His head was delivered to Lady Fiona.

name: Izek's Arm
summary: Izek's magical demon arm, later attached to Shabasta.

facts.text: Was cut off by Liren and attached to Shabasta by Malron.
Has the powers Flame Hurl and Flame Volley.

name: Fiona Wachter
summary: A noblewoman of Vallaki who opposes the Baron and later takes control of the town.

facts.text: Invited Aera to dinner at Wachterhaus.
Follows Ezra and was rescued from the woods as a girl by Lysa.
Gave the party poison wine to use against Izek.
Rewarded the party with her armory for Izek's head.
Took control of Vallaki.
Has a pet imp familiar; the gallows speaker killed her parents.
Translated the hags' Abyssal contract and started the binding circle.

name: Blinsky
summary: A toymaker in Vallaki whose store Izek set on fire.

facts.text: Was found unconscious in his burning store after a doll went missing.
Sold a noise toy to Henrik.

name: Blinsky's Toy Store
summary: Blinsky's store in Vallaki.

facts.text: Was set on fire by Izek.

name: Vallakovich
summary: The Baron of Vallaki, father of Victor.

facts.text: Had his guards shoot at Shabasta and reasserted his title.
Was cursed by Nikolai in the past.
May have executed the shoemaker Lukovich.
Still occupies the Burgomaster Mansion with Victor.

name: Victor
summary: The Baron's son, a young wizard experimenting with teleportation.

facts.text: Stella fell sick after visiting him.
His failed teleport trapped Stella in the spirit realm.
Needs a hag's heart stone to reach the Ethereal Plane.
Provided counter spells to hold the binding circle at the windmill.
Used the heart stone to take the party into the ethereal realm.

name: Stella
summary: Lady Fiona's daughter, trapped in the spirit realm by Victor's failed spell.

facts.text: Appeared as a hollow-eyed girl in a nightgown at Wachterhaus.
Her spirit appeared in a mirror; she saw a night hag near the refugee camp.
Was rescued from the spirit realm.

name: Nikolai
summary: Stella's older brother, who once cursed the Baron.

facts.text: Took Stella for a walk around the grounds.
Karl says a Nikolai, their father, died of a wasting sickness.

name: Karl
summary: Stella's younger brother.

facts.text: Said their father died of a wasting sickness.

name: Frederick
summary: Lady Fiona's older brother.

facts.text: Was supposed to be the heir until Lysa rescued Fiona.

name: Lysa
summary: A woods-witch of Berez who was Lady Fiona's mentor.

facts.text: Rescued Lady Fiona from the woods when she was young.
Lived in the swamps of Berez and worshipped Mother Night.
Baba Lysaga is referred to as Lysa, Fiona's mentor.

name: Baba Lysaga
summary: A powerful witch living in Berez who helped Strahd's allies.

facts.text: Drove the Martikov family from the vineyard with the druids; called Lysa, Fiona's mentor.
Stole one of the winery's gems three weeks ago.
Helped Ludmilla take control of the winery and lives in Berez.
Empowers Kiril, the Black Terror.
Made the silver-thorn collars and helped capture Emil.

name: Ezra
summary: Goddess of the mists who teaches endurance, followed by Lady Fiona.

facts.text: Lady Fiona prays to her and hears her, though it may be an imposter.
Lady Fiona adopted her faith after returning to Vallaki.

name: Mother Night
summary: A deity of darkness, trickery and the occult.

facts.text: Was worshipped by Lysa.
Has a cursed shrine inside the werewolf den.

name: Lathander
summary: The Morninglord, god served by Malron.

facts.text: Malron is a cleric of Lathander.
A sun-engraved holy symbol disc may be linked to him.

name: Lukovich
summary: A Vallaki shoemaker.

facts.text: Was captured and possibly executed by the Baron.

name: Berez
summary: A swampy fishing village south of Vallaki.

facts.text: Was swept away by the river when Strahd was challenged.
Lysa lived in its swamps.
Baba Lysaga lives there.

name: Sun Sword
summary: A rumored glowing sword.

facts.text: Lady Fiona heard of it but doubts it exists.
Rumored to be Strahd's father's weapon, possibly in the Amber Temple.

name: Strahd von Zarovich
summary: The vampire lord of Barovia.

facts.text: Appeared at Aera's window asking to be let in.
The Forest Folk worship him as a deity.
Offered the party a wager over stopping Winter Splinter.
Gets information from Madam Eva.
Rewarded the party at the Whispering Wall with gemstones and showed them the Twilight Crest.
Made the party play a blood hourglass game of sacrifices.
Stole the skull of Argynvost.

name: Red Dragon Kresh
summary: A bottle of poisoned wine used against Izek.

facts.text: Was given to the party by Fiona's agent.
Izek drank it at the lake.

name: Amber Shard of Seriach
summary: An amber shard looted from Izek.

facts.text: Found after the fight with Izek.

name: Hell Hound Whisperer
summary: An item looted from Izek.

facts.text: Found after the fight with Izek.

name: Bones of St. Andral
summary: Holy relics that power the ward of Vallaki's church.

facts.text: Were found in a bag in Henrik's wardrobe.
Were given to Father Lucian to renew the ward.

name: Talisman of Echoes
summary: A talisman Malron uses to speak with the dead.

facts.text: Malron used it to question Izek's head.

name: Locket of the Last Laugh
summary: An eerie locket that emits childlike laughter.

facts.text: Was found by Liren.

name: Keepers of the Feather
summary: A secret group that opposes Strahd by guiding and sheltering, using ravens.

facts.text: Izek's head revealed the Order of the Feather opposes Strahd.
Davian and Urwin Martikov are members.
Davian leads it.

name: Erasmus
summary: The spirit of a 14-year-old boy who helps Stella hide in the spirit realm.

facts.text: Wrote 'Help Victor' on a frosted window at the inn.
Told the party about the gallows speaker.
Warned the party to attack spirits near Stella.

name: Rahadin
summary: An elf servant of Strahd.

facts.text: Arrived on a phantom steed with an invitation to dinner at Castle Ravenloft.
Rolled dice to decide Milivoj's and Henrik's fates.
Strahd calls him a servant.
Killed Horngaard, commander of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

name: Castle Ravenloft
summary: Strahd's castle.

facts.text: Rahadin invited the party to dinner there.
Elvir died in a march on it.
A silver statuette there could cure the Abbot.
Emil is imprisoned in its dungeons.

name: Prince Sergei
summary: A prince whose wedding to Tatyana is recorded in the Wachter family history.

facts.text: The party read about his wedding to Tatyana.

name: Tatyana
summary: Bride of Prince Sergei.

facts.text: The party read about her wedding to Prince Sergei.

name: Vallaki
summary: A walled town where much of the party's early adventure takes place.

facts.text: Has an eastern gate and the Zarovich gate.
Lady Fiona took control of it.

name: Blue Water Inn
summary: Urwin's inn in Vallaki where the party stays.

facts.text: Was ransacked by Izek.
Erasmus's spirit wrote messages on its frosted window.
Gets its wine from the Wizard of Wines.

name: Wachterhaus
summary: Lady Fiona's manor in Vallaki, protected by a binding circle.

facts.text: The party dined there at Fiona's invitation.
Has an armory the party was rewarded from.
Is ringed by a binding circle against evil spirits.
Its cellar holds four skeletons in beds and a pentagram.

name: Burgomaster Mansion
summary: The Baron's mansion in Vallaki.

facts.text: A woman resembling Stella was seen in a mirror in its attic.
Victor runs teleportation experiments there.

name: Eastern Gate
summary: Vallaki's eastern gate.

facts.text: Refugees addicted to dream pastries try to enter there.

name: Zarovich Gate
summary: A Vallaki gate leading toward the lake.

facts.text: Izek went through it before his last fight.

name: Refugee Camp
summary: A camp of refugees outside Vallaki.

facts.text: A night hag was seen near it.
The party met Emerik, Magda and Franz there.

name: Emerik
summary: A refugee at the camp outside Vallaki.

facts.text: Greeted the party at the refugee camp.

name: Magda
summary: A refugee at the camp outside Vallaki.

facts.text: Greeted the party at the refugee camp.

name: Franz
summary: A refugee addicted to dream pastries who sold his children to Morgantha.

facts.text: Sold his children for endless pastries and hears windmill blades in his nightmares.

name: Bianca
summary: Name used for Franz's sister and for a werewolf tied to Kiril; possibly two people.

facts.text: Franz's sister Bianca cares for him.
A werewolf Bianca, torn between love and survival, told the party about the pack.

name: Morgantha Stormreaver
summary: A night hag who sold dream pastries and took children.

facts.text: Took Franz's children in exchange for dream pastries.
Her true name was learned from the coven contract and she was defeated.

name: Belladonna Sunbane
summary: A hag of the windmill coven.

facts.text: Her true name was learned from the coven contract and she was defeated.

name: Offalia Wormwiggle
summary: A hag of the windmill coven.

facts.text: Her true name was learned from the coven contract and she was defeated.

name: The Windmill
summary: A decrepit windmill where the hag coven lived.

facts.text: A clue said three black hearts beat as one in the millstone under the windmill.
The party freed kidnapped children and defeated the hags there.

name: Heart Stone
summary: A night hag's stone that allows travel to the Ethereal Plane.

facts.text: Victor needs one to reach the Ethereal Plane.
Can be gained by a deal or by killing the hag.
Victor used it to take the party into the ethereal realm.

name: Gallows Speaker
summary: A malevolent spirit that haunted Stella in the Ethereal Plane.

facts.text: Haunts Stella near Vallaki in the Ethereal Plane.
Killed Lady Fiona's parents.
Was defeated, but Shabasta died in the fight.

name: Leo Dilisnya
summary: A spirit and former guard of Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Wanted to claim Stella and Lady Fiona and shared his history with Strahd.

name: Van Richten
summary: Author of a guide on monsters whose son was kidnapped.

facts.text: Erasmus shared lore from Van Richten's guide.
Ezmerelda's family had a hand in kidnapping his son.

name: Mordenkainen
summary: A wizard whose book Victor uses.

facts.text: His book can transport up to nine creatures on a full moon with a heart stone.

name: Forest Folk
summary: Druids and hermits of the Svalich Woods who worship Strahd.

facts.text: Treat Yester Hill as sacred and worship Strahd as a deity.
Drove the Martikovs from the vineyard with their blights.
Worship Lorgoth and were preparing to summon Winter Splinter.
Split from the mountain folk long ago.

name: Mountain Folk
summary: People of the mountains who worship ancient goddesses.

facts.text: A mountain woman warned the party away from the forest folk.
Enchanted the winter wolf teeth.
Their help is needed to reach Zoldoph.

name: Svalich Woods
summary: The forest where the Forest Folk live.

facts.text: The Forest Folk dwell there.

name: Yester Hill
summary: A sacred hill at the southwest edge of the Barovian valley.

facts.text: The druids treat it as sacred.
The druids held their Winter Splinter ritual there.
Has a 50-foot fanged statue and thirteen chanting druids.

name: Ethereal Plane
summary: A misty spirit realm full of restless spirits.

facts.text: Stella was trapped there by Victor's spell.
The party entered it and rescued Stella.

name: Charm of Mass Heroism
summary: A charm granting a potion of heroism to any number of creatures within 30 feet.

facts.text: Was found by Gumbo in the windmill.

name: Mirror of Victor
summary: An enchanted mirror used to counter the hags' dispel.

facts.text: Was taken on the hag mission.

name: Spirit Mirror
summary: A hand mirror for seeing into the ethereal realm.

facts.text: Was obtained and resized into a hand mirror.

name: Tome of Strahd
summary: A book about Strahd.

facts.text: Was retrieved during the spirit realm adventure.

name: Wizard of Wines
summary: The Martikov family vineyard and winery.

facts.text: Its shipment to the Blue Water Inn was 16 days overdue.
The druids and their blights took it over.
Makes wine with three magic green gemstones.

name: Davian Martikov
summary: Head of the Martikov family and leader of the Keepers of the Feather.

facts.text: Appeared cloaked near the vineyard and led the party into a trapdoor.
Is Urwin's father and warned of the druids' staff.
Lost a son in an assault on Castle Ravenloft.
Gave the party an obsidian whistle for recovering the gem.

name: Muriel Vinshaw
summary: A vineyard employee who guided the party.

facts.text: Guided the party to the vineyard and fell into a trap.
Stayed behind to guard the tunnel exit.
Her lover, one of Davian's sons, may be the were-raven Ludmilla spoke of.
Said Strahd got a reading from Madam Eva before the party.

name: Elvir
summary: Davian Martikov's son who died attacking Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Died three months ago during a march on Castle Ravenloft.
Defied his father and joined Doru's assault.

name: Doru
summary: Leader of a failed assault on Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Led the attack that Davian's son joined.

name: Argynvostholt
summary: The ruined mansion of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: Rumored to be connected to Revenants.
Sir Godfrey warned the party to avoid its fourth floor and phase spiders.

name: Huntress
summary: An ancient goddess marked by a three-pointed star.

facts.text: The party found a monument to her near the vineyard.
Kavan told her legend with the Seeker and Weaver.

name: Seeker
summary: A figure of ancient legend.

facts.text: Kavan told the party its legend.

name: Weaver
summary: A figure of ancient legend.

facts.text: Kavan told the party its legend.

name: Lorgoth
summary: A power worshipped by the druids.

facts.text: The druids worship Lorgoth.

name: Winter Splinter
summary: A giant twig blight the druids tried to summon.

facts.text: The druids warned it would destroy everything.
Strahd said it is a giant twig blight.
Was defeated; its explosion killed Veyren.

name: Shadow Lord's Staff
summary: The druid leader's staff that controlled the blights.

facts.text: Davian said it must be destroyed or stolen.
Was destroyed by the party.

name: Winter Wolf Teeth
summary: Three teeth enchanted by mountain folk that blast cold or grant cold immunity.

facts.text: Found in a box; one was used to blast through brown mold.

name: Gemheart
summary: One of the winery's green gemstones with plant-growing magic.

facts.text: One gem was lost ten years ago, one stolen by Baba Lysaga, one taken by the druids.
Was recovered by defeating Winter Splinter.

name: Mira
summary: A companion with regenerative abilities who summoned Kavan.

facts.text: Secretly planned to meet Kavan, whom Davian disapproves of.
Summoned Kavan by dripping her blood.

name: Kavan the Blood Drinker
summary: A figure of the first folk who wields a long wooden spear.

facts.text: Was summoned by Mira and offered a deal for powerful items.
Told of the split between mountain and forest folk and the Spear of the Ladies.

name: Sverog
summary: A figure who bargained with Kavan.

facts.text: Offered Kavan a wand for a powerful weapon.

name: Madam Eva
summary: A fortune teller who gives Strahd information.

facts.text: Lets certain people pass unchallenged through Strahd's domain.
Gave Strahd a reading before the party.

name: Ludmilla
summary: A bride of Strahd.

facts.text: Was at the Winter Splinter ritual and scorned Volenta.
Planned to vivisect a were-raven that attacked Castle Ravenloft.
Strahd warned she will not forget the party.

name: Whispering Wall
summary: An ancient god's tomb that produces Barovia's mist and shows visions of desire.

facts.text: Strahd challenged the party to enter it.
Visitors hear: 'The way back comes but once.'

name: Gray Stones
summary: Gems from Strahd that cast Locate Object when crushed.

facts.text: Chosen by Gumbo, Aera and Zorpheus.

name: Silver Stones
summary: Gems from Strahd that cast Misty Step when crushed.

facts.text: Chosen by Malron and Liren.

name: Twilight Crest
summary: A moth-shaped artifact that casts Aid by day and Spirit Guardians by night.

facts.text: Strahd produced it at the Whispering Wall.

name: Minofaustus
summary: A traveling merchant with a magical market wagon.

facts.text: Sold the party magic items and handed Zorpheus to Gumbo.
Sold Oogway potions of healing.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
summary: A magic cloak.

facts.text: Gumbo got it from Minofaustus.

name: Gleaming Half Plate
summary: Magic armor.

facts.text: Liren and Malron got it from Minofaustus.

name: Shades Ring
summary: A magic ring.

facts.text: Aera got it from Minofaustus on credit.

name: Kavan's Cairn
summary: A site of ancient worship.

facts.text: Kavan told legends there.

name: Hill of Ravenloft
summary: Resting place of King Dostron.

facts.text: A legendary spear waits there.

name: King Dostron
summary: An ancient king buried at the Hill of Ravenloft.

facts.text: Rests at the Hill of Ravenloft.

name: Spear of the Ladies
summary: A legendary spear.

facts.text: Kavan says it must be retrieved.

name: Zoldoph
summary: A place the party needs to reach.

facts.text: Reaching it needs mountain folk help and a token of the Ladies.

name: Krezk
summary: A village home to the Krezkov family.

facts.text: The party traveled there and met the Krezkovs.

name: Symbol of Ravenkind
summary: A holy symbol connected to Strahd.

facts.text: Davian told its history.
Olfin received it from Zuleika.

name: Obsidian Whistle
summary: A raven-shaped whistle.

facts.text: Davian gave it for recovering the gem.

name: Dmitri Krezkov
summary: A man of Krezk with a hereditary werewolf curse.

facts.text: Was tricked by the Abbot into skipping wolfsbane and killed his sister as a werewolf.

name: Anna Krezkov
summary: Dmitri's wife.

facts.text: Harvests wolfsbane to ease Dmitri's curse.
The Abbot wants her heart in a month to revive the dead sister.

name: The Abbot
summary: An angelic being tainted by Strahd who runs St. Markovia Abbey.

facts.text: Is building a reanimated corpse needing a willing victim's heart.
Is crafting Vasilka as a companion for Strahd.
Deceived Ilya.

name: St. Markovia Abbey
summary: A mountain abbey twisted by the Abbot's experiments.

facts.text: The Abbot has taken it over.
The party held a séance there with Ezmerelda.

name: Vasilka
summary: A flesh golem the Abbot is building for Strahd.

facts.text: The Abbot believes she can break the land's curse.

name: Ezmerelda
summary: A monster hunter who lost her leg to the Black Terror.

facts.text: Held a séance with the party at the abbey.
Led the party to the werewolf den and gave Malron Darkvision.

name: Belview Family
summary: A family mutated by the Abbot's experiments.

facts.text: Includes Otto, Zygfrek and Clovin.

name: Otto
summary: A mutated member of the Belview family.

facts.text: Met at the abbey.

name: Zygfrek
summary: A mutated member of the Belview family.

facts.text: Met at the abbey.

name: Clovin
summary: A mutated member of the Belview family.

facts.text: Met at the abbey.

name: Cyrus Belview
summary: A Belview held in Ravenloft.

facts.text: May bring rewards if rescued from Ravenloft.

name: Marzena
summary: A woman at the abbey who sent a flower necklace to a sibling.

facts.text: Gave a necklace for her sibling in the East Wing.

name: Necklace of Flowers
summary: Marzena's gift for her sibling.

facts.text: Malron carries it.

name: Lake Baratok Cave
summary: The werewolf den near Lake Baratok.

facts.text: Holds the kidnapped Ilya.
The party fought five werewolves there.
Contains the Shrine of Mother Night.

name: Kiril Stoyanovich
summary: The werewolf pack leader, empowered by Baba Lysaga.

facts.text: Leads the werewolf pack.
Took Ezmerelda's leg.
Captured Emil with help from Strahd and Baba Lysaga.

name: Ilya
summary: A werewolf prisoner in the Lake Baratok cave.

facts.text: Was kidnapped and held in the werewolf cave.
Wore a silver-thorn collar and said the Abbot deceived him.

name: Zuleika
summary: A werewolf prisoner sworn to free Emil.

facts.text: Gave Olfin the Symbol of Ravenkind for the party's oath.

name: Emil
summary: The missing leader of the werewolves, held in Ravenloft.

facts.text: Was captured by Kiril and jailed in Ravenloft's dungeons.

name: Wondrous Flint and Steel
summary: A flint and steel that makes smokeless fire.

facts.text: Ezmerelda used it to hide the party's camp.

name: Shrine of Mother Night
summary: A cursed altar in the werewolf den.

facts.text: Holds a cursed ruby medallion, gems and gold.

name: Silver-thorn Collars
summary: Collars made by Baba Lysaga that block werewolf transformation.

facts.text: Worn by Ilya and Zuleika.

name: Ruby Medallion
summary: A cursed medallion from the Shrine of Mother Night.

facts.text: Found in the shrine, part of a cursed treasure.

name: Order of the Silver Dragon
summary: A fallen knightly order based at Argynvostholt.

facts.text: Its commander Horngaard was slain by Rahadin.

name: Sir Godfrey Gwilym
summary: A spectral knight of the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: Told the party the order's history and warned them of dangers.

name: Argynvost
summary: The Silver Dragon honored by the Order of the Silver Dragon.

facts.text: Strahd stole his skull.

name: Horngaard
summary: Slain commander of the Order of the Silver Dragon, now a vengeful presence.

facts.text: Was killed by Rahadin; his chamber should be avoided.

name: Amber Temple
